freeTier.summary: The Starter Site plan is free with no time limit, but it publishes only to a webflow.io subdomain and is capped at 2 static pages, 50 CMS items (20 Collections), 1 GB bandwidth (which Webflow says usually covers ~250 page views a month) and 50 form submissions over the site's lifetime. The free Starter Workspace includes 1 full seat, 2 staging sites and 200 AI credits a month. Webflow asks for a payment method when you first subscribe to a paid plan.

trial.summary: No time-limited trial of paid plans; Webflow points to the free Starter plan instead ('Try Webflow for as long as you like'). New Site and Workspace plan purchases, monthly or annual, are fully refundable if you cancel and request a refund within 14 days of the initial purchase.

usage.name: Webflow Cloud web app requests
usage.unit: per 1 million requests above the plan allowance

usage.name: Webflow Cloud CPU usage
usage.unit: per 5 hours of CPU usage above the plan allowance
usage.note: Allowance: 15 CPU minutes on Starter and Basic, 30 CPU minutes on Premium. Database storage and operations have their own $2 overage steps; Webflow gives at least 30 days notice before charging for those overages.

extraCosts.label: Ecommerce Standard transaction fee
extraCosts.display: 2% of each sale on Ecommerce Standard
extraCosts.note: Charged in addition to Stripe or PayPal processing fees; Ecommerce Plus and Advanced charge 0%.

extraCosts.label: Automatic bandwidth upgrade after overage
extraCosts.display: Automatic upgrade to a higher bandwidth tier after 2 consecutive months over the limit
extraCosts.note: The first month over the limit is not charged (surge protection). If the site is over again the next billing month, the plan or bandwidth add-on is upgraded at the start of the following billing month, sized to the lower of the two months' usage. These upgrades are non-refundable, and bot traffic counts toward bandwidth.

billingNotes: Site plans and the Workspace are separate subscriptions: each site published to a custom domain needs its own Site plan, while the Workspace plan and any paid seats are billed on their own. One card on file pays for both.
Yearly billing is cheaper: Basic $15 vs $25, Premium $25 vs $39, Limited seat $15 vs $19 and Full seat $39 vs $45 per month. Webflow advertises 'Save up to 40%'.
The Team platform plan ($2,500/mo) requires an annual contract and has no monthly option.
Switching the Workspace plan between monthly and yearly billing also switches the billing frequency of its paid seats.

Cancelling keeps a plan active until the end of the term, and you still pay the remainder of the term. Only new Site and Workspace plan purchases are refundable (within 14 days); renewals, seats, add-ons, AI credits and bandwidth auto-upgrades are not.
Upgrades, downgrades and billing-frequency switches are prorated, with any credit held as Workspace credit rather than refunded.

May 2026 price change: the CMS and Business plans were merged into Premium ($25/mo yearly, $39/mo monthly) and Basic went up to $15/mo yearly, $25/mo monthly. Existing sites move over at their next renewal or billable change from June 29, 2026, or from November 16, 2026 for sites in Freelancer or Agency Workspaces and sites on legacy pricing from 2022 or earlier. Switching from monthly to yearly billing before the change applies locks in the current plan for one more year.
Bandwidth is metered per site and counts traffic from bots as well as people.
AI credits reset every month on self-serve Workspace plans and unused credits don't roll over.
Prices are in USD, with applicable taxes added at checkout.

regional.note: Webflow publishes one price list in USD ('All prices in USD, per site, plus applicable taxes added at checkout') and issues invoices only in USD. Checked from a US locale only.

scenarios.label: Solo: 1 site, 1 editor, ~20-page blog, ~10k visits/mo
scenarios.assumptions: The blog needs the CMS, so Premium is the cheapest plan that fits (Basic has no CMS). The owner is the only editor and uses the full seat included in the free Starter Workspace. Bandwidth is our estimate: we treat each visit as roughly one page view at about 3.3-4 MB, which is Webflow’s own mid-point guidance per page view (50 GB ‘usually covers 5k–25k page views’, i.e. 2-10 MB each; 1 GB ‘usually covers ~250 page views’, i.e. ~4 MB). At ~10k visits that is ~33-40 GB a month, inside the 50 GB Premium includes. Month-to-month billing.

lines.label: Premium Site plan, billed monthly (includes 50 GB bandwidth)
Starter Workspace with the owner's included full seat

scenarios.note: Billed yearly the same setup is $25/mo. Bandwidth is the uncertain part: a heavy site (Webflow's range allows ~10 MB per page view) could pass 50 GB, and the 100 GB option adds $30/mo billed monthly.

scenarios.label: Small team: 1 site, 3 editors, ~200 CMS items, ~50k visits/mo
scenarios.assumptions: Premium covers the CMS (20,000 items). The owner uses the included full seat; the other 2 editors get Limited seats (Content editor or Marketer role), which Webflow lets any Workspace plan buy, including the free Starter Workspace: 2 x $19 = $38. Bandwidth is our estimate: we treat each visit as roughly one page view at about 3.3-4 MB, which is Webflow’s own mid-point guidance per page view (50 GB ‘usually covers 5k–25k page views’, i.e. 2-10 MB each; 1 GB ‘usually covers ~250 page views’, i.e. ~4 MB). At ~50k visits that is ~167-200 GB a month, which needs the 200 GB bandwidth option (+150 GB). Month-to-month billing.

Starter Workspace with the owner's included full seat

scenarios.note: Billed yearly: $25 + $60 + 2 x $15 = $115/mo. At the most optimistic end of Webflow's range (~2 MB per page view) the 100 GB option (+$30) would be enough, making it $107/mo month-to-month.

scenarios.label: Growing team: 1 site, 8 editors, ~1,000 CMS items, ~250k visits/mo
scenarios.assumptions: Premium covers the CMS (20,000 items). The owner uses the included full seat; the other 7 editors get Limited seats: 7 x $19 = $133. The free Starter Workspace is kept because no Workspace limit forces an upgrade (Growth, $60/mo monthly, adds per-site publishing permissions and site-level roles). Bandwidth is our estimate: we treat each visit as roughly one page view at about 3.3-4 MB, which is Webflow’s own mid-point guidance per page view (50 GB ‘usually covers 5k–25k page views’, i.e. 2-10 MB each; 1 GB ‘usually covers ~250 page views’, i.e. ~4 MB). At ~250k visits that is ~833 GB-1 TB a month, which needs the 1 TB option (+950 GB). Month-to-month billing.

lines.label: Bandwidth add-on to 1 TB total (+950 GB), billed monthly
Starter Workspace with the owner's included full seat

scenarios.note: Billed yearly: $25 + $374 + 7 x $15 = $504/mo. At the most optimistic end of Webflow's range (~2 MB per page view) the 500 GB option (+$260 monthly) would be enough: $432/mo month-to-month. Bandwidth, not seats, drives this bill.

unverified: Bandwidth per visit: Webflow publishes only a page-view range (50 GB ‘usually covers 5k–25k page views’), not a per-visit figure, so the bandwidth option in each scenario is our estimate of ~3.3-4 MB per visit (about one page view per visit). Sites with several page views per visit, heavy images or video, or a lot of bot traffic (which Webflow counts) would need a higher bandwidth tier.
Team platform plan: only the $2,500/mo headline is published; the cost of extra sites or seats on Team is quoted by sales.
Enterprise plans and Optimize for non-Webflow sites are quote-only.
Localize month-to-month prices for more than one added locale were not captured; only the 1-locale monthly prices ($12 Essential, $35 Advanced) and the per-locale yearly prices are recorded.
Whether Webflow charges different prices by country was not checked outside a US locale.

Webflow's 'Choose a Site plan' help article still says the free Starter plan allows up to 1,000 monthly visits, while the pricing page says its 1 GB bandwidth usually covers ~250 page views; this record follows the pricing page.
